An ES2017 spec-compliant `Object.values` shim. Invoke its "shim" method to shim `Object.values` if it is unavailable or noncompliant.

This package implements the [es-shim API](https://example.invalid/es-shims/api) interface. It works in an ES3-supported environment and complies with the [spec](https://example.invalid/ecma262/#sec-object.values).

Most common usage:
```js
var assert = require('assert');
var values = require('object.values');

var obj = { a: 1, b: 2, c: 3 };
var expected = [1, 2, 3];

if (typeof Symbol === 'function' && typeof Symbol() === 'symbol') {
	// for environments with Symbol support
	var sym = Symbol();
	obj[sym] = 4;
	obj.d = sym;
	expected.push(sym);
}

assert.deepEqual(values(obj), expected);

if (!Object.values) {
	values.shim();
}

assert.deepEqual(Object.values(obj), expected);
```

## Tests
Simply clone the repo, `npm install`, and run `npm test`
